notes.title: Halloween discount and update
notes.content:
Friends, gamers, countrymen!
All Along the Toon Tower team has released a little Halloween-themed update! Just to (pumpkin-) spice things up a little, and as a thank you for all the amazing support this little indie project of ours has been getting.

In addition to that we are happy to offer a discount in honour of the spookiest holiday of the year!

Don't forget to: eat plenty of vitamins B12, A, and iron (which can all be found in liver); avoid walking alone at night in ghost-ridden parts of Tokyo; whistle a merry tune once and again; and be mindful about who you let into your house!

Happy holidays from the Violent Horror Stories Anthology teams!
